summary: Route Open-Meteo operations through the service-specific host declared for each API instead of assuming the forecast host serves every endpoint.
reason: Open-Meteo serves historical and air-quality data from archive-api.open-meteo.com and air-quality-api.open-meteo.com. Sending /archive or /air-quality to api.open-meteo.com returns HTTP 404, and activity checks silently degrade AQI to zero.
validated_outcome: Regression tests assert the selected hosts; live smoke tests return historical weather, air quality, and nonzero AQI in activity verdicts.
